title: tests/kernel/test_kpp.c: in-kernel tests for ECDH and DH
description: Kernel module testing ECDH P-256, ECDH P-384, and DH key agreement. For ECDH: load a known private key (from tests/vectors), generate public key, compute shared secret with a known peer public key, compare against expected shared secret from NIST test vectors. For DH: use RFC 3526 group 14 (2048-bit MODP) with known private key and peer public key, compute shared secret, compare. Print pass/fail per check.
design: Use crypto_alloc_kpp(). ECDH secret blob format: struct ecdh from include/crypto/ecdh.h (curve_id, key, key_size). DH secret blob: struct dh from include/crypto/dh.h. Use crypto_kpp_set_secret(). kpp_request_alloc and crypto_kpp_generate_public_key / crypto_kpp_compute_shared_secret. NIST test vectors for ECDH P-256 KAS from SP 800-56A.
